Title: Azure Batch client library for .NET updated

Body.Content:
The Azure Batch client library is updated to v1.1.0. The new Batch client library has the following changes:
  • The synchronous versions of the API calls can be used in GUI and ASP.NET message pump threads without deadlocking.
  • Updated IntelliSense documents.
  • Minor bug fixes.
You can get more information about the updates and read the Release Notes on the Microsoft Azure Batch 1.1.0 page on NuGet. Azure Batch code samples are updated to use the latest Batch client library. For more information, see Developer code samples.
